values.note: Single site $24, double site $48, group site $55 a night; dump station $5 per use for non-campers.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/beartree-recreation-area ('Single Site: $24 per night, Double Site: $48 per night, Group Site: $55 per night, Dump Station: $5 per use (non-campers)') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232384/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-13 to 2026-10-31: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 24), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232384 (notice 'No hookups are available at campsites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 35 units in Chipmunk Circle and 35 in Beaver Flats for tents and RVs, plus 4 walk-in tent group sites and 4 paved RV group sites. RVs up to 40 ft in some units; catalog sites are all back-in. One RV per parking spur.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232384 ('There are 35 camping units in Chipmunk Circle and 35 units in Beaver Flats'; 'Recreation vehicles up to 40 feet can be accommodated in some units'; 'Limit one RV per parking spur') + recreation.gov campsite catalog (Driveway Entry 'Back-In' on every standard site), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Normally bathhouses with toilets, warm showers and drinking water, and a dump station (no water) by the contact station. 2026: only Chipmunk Loop open (from May 14, all first-come); no water until the well is repaired (Helene damaged the water system), bathhouses closed, a portable toilet near site 11; Beartree Lake drained, beach and picnic area closed.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232384 ('Bathhouses with toilets, warm showers, sinks, and drinking water are provided'; 'A dump station (no water) is located on the left side of the road before the contact station') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/beartree-recreation-area ('Beartree Campground will open Chipmunk Loop starting on May 14th ... All sites in Chipmunk will be first-come, first-served. There will be no water available in Chipmunk Loop ... Bathrooms will be closed'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/beartree-recreation-area ('Seasons of Use: Mid-May through late October'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Some sites reservable on recreation.gov, others first-come (2026: Chipmunk Loop only, all first-come; group sites reservable). 14 consecutive nights. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon. No cell coverage.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232384 ('Some sites are available for reservations while others are available on a first-come, first-served basis'; notice 'This campground has first-come, first-serve sites and reservable sites'; rule maxConsecutiveStay 14) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/beartree-recreation-area (2026 Chipmunk notice), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Senior and Access passes: 50% off the base campsite fee.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/beartree-recreation-area ('The America the Beautiful Senior and Access Passes provide a 50% discount to the base campsite fee'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed $24 single (2026), no electric, dump station, reservable on recreation.gov. Added no water/sewer at sites, 70 units to 40 ft (back-in), showers/flush toilets/drinking water (normally), mid-May to late October season, some first-come sites, 14-night limit, senior/access 50%. 2026 partial closure (Chipmunk only, first-come, no water, bathhouses closed; lake drained) recorded in the group notes.
flags: Entry phone is empty. The Forest Service gives 276-783-5196 (Mount Rogers NRA office; recreation.gov lists 800-628-7202).

2026 partial closure: only Chipmunk Loop is open, all first-come, with no water and bathhouses closed (Helene damage to the water system); Beaver Flats not opened; Beartree Lake drained and the beach/picnic area closed. A note line may be wanted; the --AWH note ('Reservable during peak season', creek-side sites) was left as is.
